text:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — Trustline Bank POC wants: SOC 2 extract, signed pen-test attestation, and a private artifact area. They also want to know if a 2-week Dedicated pilot changes the POC billing vs hosted credits. Need turnaround 72h.

Ravi P: We can provide a redacted SOC2 excerpt + our pen-test attestation template. For a signed attestation letter we require an NDA and a named signatory (name/title/email). We do not hand over raw vuln reports or private key material.

Elena (Security): Dataroom options: 1) short-lived private dataroom (preferred); 2) SFTP with presigned URLs (if customer insists on automated pulls). Both require completed assurance intake form. Link: https://redwood.example.com/assurance/dataroom-request. Include desired TTL, contact, and NDA.

Maya (AE): Customer asked for KMS custody diagram as part of artifacts. Can we share a redacted flow?

Elena (Security): Yes — redacted KMS flow diagram OK (no IPs, no key material). We will watermark and include an access log. If they request raw scans, escalate to SOC and legal.

Maya (AE): On pricing: they specifically asked if Dedicated trial billing is prorated or requires a minimum commit.

FinOps Bot: Summary: Hosted POC = billed to free credits or pay-as-you-go usage. Dedicated pilot requires a short-term reserved pool and a signed commitment; we can prorate for partial months but finance needs approval for <30 day commits. For a 2-week pool we'll provide a provisional quote.

Ravi P: I'll prepare the redacted SOC2 + pen-test template once NDA + signatory are attached. Paste to security email to speed up:

```
To: security@redwood.com
Subject: Trustline Bank - Dataroom + Signed Attestation
Customer: Trustline Bank
Signatory: TBD (name, title, email)
NDA: attached
Artifacts requested: SOC2 excerpt (redacted), pen-test attestation (signed), redacted KMS diagram
TTL: 14 days
```

Dataroom Bot: Ticket created: DR-2026-041. Expected SLA: 1 business day after intake + NDA.

Maya (AE): Customer wants everything before their procurement review next Tuesday. I'll chase NDA/signatory. @FinOps Bot please drop the 2-week Dedicated estimate when ready.

FinOps Bot: Will upload a one-page quote in ~3h.

Elena (Security): Quick note — if they ask for insurance/attestation language tweaks, we need legal review. Keep requests high level for now.

Maya (AE): Thanks all, looping in customer now.
